steps.say: Osteonecrosis, also called avascular or aseptic necrosis, results from compromised microvascular blood supply to bone, leading to osteocyte death, subchondral microfractures, and eventual articular surface collapse. Starved bone dies, cracks, then caves. Infarct, not infection, starts the fall, and the surface outlives the bone beneath until it crumbles.
steps.tx: **Osteonecrosis** (avascular necrosis, aseptic necrosis) results from compromised **microvascular blood supply** to bone, leading to **osteocyte death**, subchondral microfractures, and eventual articular surface **collapse**. Starved bone dies, cracks, then caves. Infarct, not infection, starts the fall, and the surface outlives the bone beneath until it crumbles.

steps.say: The femoral head is the most frequent anatomical site, bilateral in over seventy percent of non-traumatic cases. Major systemic etiologies are systemic glucocorticoid therapy, heavy alcohol consumption, sickle cell disease, systemic lupus erythematosus, and decompression sickness. Both hips in steroid or sickle hosts earn both-side imaging.
steps.tx: The **femoral head** is the most frequent anatomical site, bilateral in over **70%** of non-traumatic cases. Major systemic etiologies include systemic **glucocorticoid** therapy, heavy **alcohol** consumption, **sickle cell disease**, systemic lupus erythematosus, and **decompression sickness**. Both hips in steroid or sickle hosts earn both-side imaging.

steps.say: Magnetic resonance imaging is the gold standard diagnostic modality in early pre-radiographic stages, displaying a focal subchondral serpiginous band of low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and the pathognomonic double line sign on T2-weighted images. Resonance sees death months before radiographs do.
steps.tx: **Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)** is the **gold standard** diagnostic modality in early pre-radiographic stages, displaying a focal subchondral **serpiginous band** of low signal intensity on **T1-weighted** images and the pathognomonic **double line sign** on **T2-weighted** images. Resonance sees death months before radiographs do.

The image pairs hip scans with a wavy **serpiginous band** on the left and a layered **double line sign** on the right within the **femoral head**. These marks reveal early death months before plain films change. Spot them as gold standard proof that infarct, not arthritis, explains pain in an at risk hip.
steps.say: Two matching hip scans sit side by side. The left marks a wavy dark band across the ball of the hip. The right marks two thin parallel lines in the same spot. Both point to bone death long before a plain film would show collapse. Seeing either sign in a painful hip should prompt staging and joint saving plans before roundness is lost.

vis.alt: Paired hip MRI views marking a serpiginous band on one side and a double line sign in the femoral head.
vis.caption: Early hip death signs on MRI, Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.say: The Ficat-Arlet and Steinberg radiographic staging systems classify femoral head osteonecrosis from stage zero with normal radiograph and MRI to stage four with subchondral collapse, crescent sign, joint space loss, and secondary osteoarthritis. Staging steers scalpels. Zero is pristine imaging; four is collapse with arthritis. The number chooses the operation.
steps.tx: The **Ficat-Arlet** and **Steinberg** radiographic staging systems classify femoral head osteonecrosis from **stage 0** (normal radiograph and MRI) to **stage IV** (subchondral **collapse**, **crescent sign**, joint space loss, and secondary osteoarthritis). Staging steers scalpels. Zero is pristine imaging; four is collapse with arthritis. The number chooses the operation.

steps.say: The crescent sign on plain radiographs represents a linear subchondral lucency indicating structural microfracture and detachment of necrotic trabeculae from overlying intact articular cartilage, predicting imminent mechanical collapse. Seeing the crescent ends joint-saving plans. Lucency under intact cartilage means the beams below have already detached.
steps.tx: The **crescent sign** on plain radiographs represents a linear **subchondral lucency** indicating structural microfracture and detachment of necrotic trabeculae from overlying intact articular cartilage, predicting **imminent mechanical collapse**. Seeing the crescent ends joint-saving plans. Lucency under intact cartilage means the beams below have already detached.

The radiograph shows a thin dark **crescent lucency** under smooth **intact cartilage** on the femoral ball, labeled as **imminent collapse**. Lucency means dead beams have detached below a still whole surface. Treat this line as the end of drilling plans because roundness is about to fail toward replacement.
steps.say: This hip film centers on the ball of the thigh bone inside its socket. A thin dark curve hugs the top of the ball just beneath a smooth white rim. Labels call out intact surface above and collapse ahead. The dark curve means the bone below has cracked away while the surface still looks whole, so joint saving work will no longer hold.

vis.alt: Hip radiograph showing a thin crescent lucency beneath intact cartilage signaling imminent collapse of the femoral head.
vis.caption: Crescent line warning of collapse, Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.say: In pre-collapse stages Ficat one and two, joint-preserving surgical interventions such as core decompression with or without bone marrow aspirate concentrate decrease elevated intraosseous pressure, stimulate angiogenesis, and delay disease progression. The dome is drilled before it deforms. Venting pressure invites vessels back and buys years before metal.
steps.tx: In pre-collapse stages (**Ficat I and II**), joint-preserving surgical interventions such as **core decompression** (with or without **bone marrow aspirate concentrate** [BMAC]) decrease elevated intraosseous pressure, stimulate **angiogenesis**, and delay disease progression. The dome is drilled before it deforms. Venting pressure invites vessels back and buys years before metal.

rows: Lowers pressure, stimulates vessels, delays progress

steps.say: Once structural femoral head collapse or crescent sign has developed at Ficat three and four, core decompression is ineffective, and total hip arthroplasty is the definitive surgical management of choice. Metal replaces crumble once roundness is lost. No drilling resurrects a collapsed dome.
steps.tx: Once structural femoral head **collapse** or crescent sign has developed (**Ficat III and IV**), **core decompression** is ineffective, and **total hip arthroplasty (THA)** is the definitive surgical management of choice. Metal replaces crumble once roundness is lost. No drilling resurrects a collapsed dome.

points: Ficat I and II, no collapse
left.title: Drill in time

steps.say: Medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw is a distinct entity defined by exposed necrotic bone in the maxillofacial region persisting more than eight weeks in patients exposed to antiresorptive agents such as zoledronic acid or denosumab or antiangiogenic drugs without prior radiation therapy. Bare jaw bone on these drugs is its own disease.
steps.tx: **Medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ)** is a distinct entity defined by **exposed necrotic bone** in the maxillofacial region persisting **>8 weeks** in patients exposed to **antiresorptive** agents (**zoledronic acid**, **denosumab**) or **antiangiogenic** drugs without prior radiation therapy. Bare jaw bone on these drugs is its own disease.
